eligibilityRuleSet.customerCopy: For members whose profile country is Kenya, with an activated Akiba Pass and no previous voucher redemption at Arabica. Use only on Saturday or Sunday.

allocation.title: 10% off your bill at Arabica Coffee House
allocation.description: Going to Arabica Coffee House this weekend? Claim 10% off your bill, up to KES 200.
allocation.termsText: 10% off the actual bill, capped at KES 200. Minimum bill KES 300. One voucher per member. Redemption on Saturday and Sunday in Africa/Nairobi, 31 October–29 November 2026. Requires a Kenya profile country, an activated Akiba Pass, and no previous voucher redemption at Arabica. Receipt/POS reference required.
